description.value: King's Choice Indian Cuisine is an Indian restaurant located in Surrey's Whalley neighbourhood on 152 Street. The business was present in OSM as an active restaurant, though current operational status is unclear. A touring cyclist passing through this part of Surrey would find it a potential stop for Indian food on a busy commercial corridor.
